source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: At the close of the opposing turn, **[Covert Stealth Team](vsdata:ability/astra-militarum.gaunts-ghosts.covert-stealth-team)** can send Gaunt’s Ghosts to [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves) if they are unengaged. They gain **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)** through your next [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), with the grant expiring as your following [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) begins. They must return by [Ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move) in that Movement phase, including on turn one.

typedMechanics.grantExpires: start of next own Shooting phase
